title: Something of the Sort
description: A "Cozy" modpack thrown together for my own entertainment, brought directly to modrinth for... no particular reason whatsoever!
body:
Something of the Sort is a small, cozy little modpack, held together by pieces of string and twine.

You might be wondering, 'Why should i download this and not all the other "cozy" modpacks?' Well to give you an answer, heres why!

Features:
- 🏰**Structures** - I added tons of structure mods to make exploring much more intresting.
- ⚔️**Better Combat** - Fight your way through hoards of mobs using a brand new combat system!
- 🎙️**Voice Chat** - Keep quiet, or something might hear you...
- 🍛**New Food** - With farmer's delight, you have a whole variety of dishes to create!
- ☀️**Seasons** - Make a calendar to keep track of time, stockpile food for the winter!
- 🎨**Polished HUD** - Everything has a clean feel so you are immersed 100% of the time.
- 🍃**Particles** - Everything has particles for enhanced immersion.
- 📷**Other Visual Improvments** - Many other visual improvments that enhance the experience. 
- 🎚️**Quality Of Life** - Small tweaks to make life so much easier.
  
- 🌫️**Herobrine** - ...
  
  If you have any questions, or want to play with others using this modpack, join the discord!
